messages:
aisha: Heads-up — hit a parity bug between REST and the Node SDK when omitting an optional routing param (route_fallback). REST returns fallback route OK, SDK returns 400. Repro steps below, any ideas?

ben: can you paste the minimal repro (curl + node snippet)?

aisha: sure — curl does this and succeeds:

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/routes -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{
  "name": "edge-case-route"
}'

node snippet (using sdk-js):
```js
const res = await client.routes.create({
  name: 'edge-case-route'
  // no route_fallback provided
})
console.log(res) // 400 { error: 'missing route_fallback' }
```

tom: weird. REST treats it as optional. @ben was there a recent rename or alias change in the API? :thinking:

ben: we introduced an alias in the API (fallback_route <-> route_fallback) but server handles missing fields. my guess: sdk is serializing undefined to null which trips validation. can you capture the outgoing JSON payload?

aisha: grabbing logs — sdk payload = { name: 'edge-case-route', route_fallback: null } while curl payload omits the key entirely. so yup null vs absent.

sara: confirming: server validation treats explicit null as missing required value for that field. workaround for now is to explicitly delete the key before send or pass fallback_route: '' — but that's gross. we'll open a SDK patch to not emit nulls for optional fields.

devops-bot: canary deploy scheduled for infra changes at 23:45 UTC (FYI)

ben: created GH issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/issues/4921 and draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/pull/1234 — change is to filter out undefined/null when building payload and add a test covering optional route_fallback.

aisha: installed patched local build, tested against staging — behaves like REST (no fallback key => server chooses default). verified. thanks!

sara: will update sampleapp + quickstart note to call out the workaround and include the new SDK release in the changelog. marking this thread as tracked in the issue :white_check_mark:
